output.summary: MAS issued revised Notices 656, 643 and 643A for banks on 4 Sep, opened a stablecoin consultation (closes 16 Oct), and the Bill introduced TLAC powers.

citations.quote: MAS Notice 656 (Amendment No.2) 2026 (565.3 KB) dated 4 September 2026 takes effect.
The amendments reflected in this document take effect on 4 September 2027.
MAS Notice 643A (521.3 KB) (including Appendix 9 Reporting Statement (45.2 KB)) dated 4 September 2026 and effective 4 September 2027.
The Bill seeks to empower MAS to impose on systemically important financial institutions (“FIs”) the requirement to maintain a minimum level of total loss-absorbing capacity (“TLAC”).
Start Date: - 01 September 2026 - Closing Date: - 16 October 2026
